n = int(input())
m = int(input())
p = int(input())

N = 510
c = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
f = [0] * N
g = [0] * N
dp = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
ways = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
dp2 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
ways2 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
dp0 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
ways0 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

def add(x, y):
    return (x + y) % p

def cal(x):
    return (x * (x - 1) // 2) % p

# Initialize binomial coefficients
for i in range(N):
    c[i][0] = 1
for i in range(1, N):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j]) % p

# Initialize f and g
f[0] = 0
g[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        add1 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * f[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
        add2 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * f[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
        val = add(add(add1, add2), (c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p) * ((cal(j) + cal(i - j + 1)) % p) % p)
        g[i] = add(g[i], c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p)
        f[i] = add(f[i], val)

# Initialize dp and ways
dp[0][0] = 0
ways[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(N):
        for k in range(N):
            dp2[j][k] = 0
            ways2[j][k] = 0
    for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
        for k in range(min(j, m) + 1):
            if k == 0:
                dp0[i][j] = dp[j][0]
                ways0[i][j] = ways[j][0]
            add(dp2[j][0], dp[j][k])
            add(ways2[j][0], ways[j][k])
            rem = m - (j - k)
            if rem >= 0:
                add(ways2[j + 1][k + 1], ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p)
                add(dp2[j + 1][k + 1], (dp0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p + ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * f[k + 1] % p))
    for j in range(N):
        for k in range(N):
            dp[j][k] = dp2[j][k]
            ways[j][k] = ways2[j][k]

ans = 0
for i in range(m + 1):
    ans = add(ans, dp[m][i])

print(ans)
